system.description:
Beginning at 3rd level you lean maneuvers that are fueled by a special dice called Superiority Dice

Maneuvers: You learn four maneuvers of your choice, which are detailed in the Pathfinder Maneuvers Section at the end of this class. You earn more at higher levels as shown in the “Maneuvers Known” Column of the Superior Movement table. Many Maneuvers enhance an attack in some way. You can use one maneuver as part of an attack or jutsu casting, once each.
